carbon-dioxide.basis: ideal gas; Shomate Cp in J/mol/K, t = T[K]/1000
carbon-dioxide.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook gas Shomate coefficients (Chase 1998); CODATA formation enthalpy

water.basis: ideal gas; Shomate Cp in J/mol/K, t = T[K]/1000
water.source: IAPWS R6-95(2018) eq. 5 and table 1; NIST-JANAF H-064 298.15 K entropy
water.note: Shomate fit; anchored at 298.15 K to formation enthalpy -241826 J/mol and entropy 188.834 J/(mol K); see analyses/mea_parameter_bundle/water-ideal-gas/fit.json.

methyldiethanolamine.basis: ideal gas; Cp = sum(a_k*(T - T_ref)^k), T_ref = 313.15 K; Cp in J/(mol K); coefficients in ascending k
methyldiethanolamine.source: Retained neumann_cubic from analyses/mdea_mea_workflow/results/diagnosis-unloaded-cp/summary.json; cubic approximation of Neumann et al. 2022 Eq. 5, Table 8 (Zotero CA5R9QN8), recentered at 313.15 K during input preparation
methyldiethanolamine.anchor_basis: h=s=0 at 313.15 K, MEA amine convention
